---
title: "deMULTIplex2 diagnostics"
subtitle: "Per-tube HTO assignment plots, drawn from the stored demultiplexing results"
---

{{< include ../_provenance.qmd >}}

deMULTIplex2 (`demultiplexTags()`, run per tube in `demux_res_<compartment>`) writes these plots
to a PDF; the pipeline discards that PDF and keeps the full result instead, so the plots are
redrawn here from it (`dm2_summary_plot()`, `dm2_diagnostic_plots()` in `src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R`).

- **Summary**: UMAP of the HTO counts, coloured by the final assignment (tag, multiplet, negative)
  and by the number of tags called per cell.
- **Per tag**: the EM fit for one tag: tag UMIs against cosine similarity and total UMIs, the
  residual, and the posterior probability of being tag-positive (called if > 0.5), on the UMAP too.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(targets)
source("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R")

demux <- list(
  Stroma = tar_read(demux_res_stroma),
  HSC    = tar_read(demux_res_hsc),
  MNC    = tar_read(demux_res_mnc)
)

draw <- function(g) { grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(g) }
```

## Assignment counts

```{r}
#| label: counts
counts <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(demux), function(cmp) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(demux[[cmp]]), function(rx) {
    tab <- table(demux[[cmp]][[rx]]$assign_table$droplet_type)
    data.frame(compartment = cmp, tube = rx,
               singlet   = as.integer(tab["singlet"]),
               multiplet = as.integer(tab["multiplet"]),
               negative  = as.integer(tab["negative"]))
  }))
}))
counts[is.na(counts)] <- 0L
counts$singlet_pct <- round(100 * counts$singlet / rowSums(counts[, c("singlet", "multiplet", "negative")]), 1)
counts
```

## Summary per tube

```{r}
#| label: summary
#| output: asis
#| fig-width: 15
#| fig-height: 8
cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
for (cmp in names(demux)) for (rx in names(demux[[cmp]])) {
  cat("## ", cmp, " — ", rx, "\n\n", sep = "")
  draw(dm2_summary_plot(demux[[cmp]][[rx]]))
  cat("\n\n")
}
cat(":::\n")
```

## Per-tag diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: diagnostics
#| output: asis
#| fig-width: 15
#| fig-height: 8
cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
for (cmp in names(demux)) for (rx in names(demux[[cmp]])) {
  cat("## ", cmp, " — ", rx, "\n\n", sep = "")
  plots <- dm2_diagnostic_plots(demux[[cmp]][[rx]])
  for (tag in names(plots)) {
    cat("**", tag, "**\n\n", sep = "")
    draw(plots[[tag]])
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
cat(":::\n")
```
